grades.reason: Only tangentially related: it says p->lock prevents a timer interrupt from forcing a yield during swtch. It never says that acquiring a spinlock disables interrupts or explains why.

grades.quote: Finally, a device interrupt handler that modifies the same data as some interruptible code could damage the data if the interrupt occurs at just the wrong time.
grades.reason: It gives background on the hazard: an interrupt handler that touches the same data as interruptible code can corrupt it. That is the motivation for disabling interrupts. It does not mention spinlocks disabling interrupts or the deadlock case.
